sentences.l2: 每逢春运，铁路客流量骤增，许多在外务工者、学生和探亲者都希望尽快返乡。
sentences.l1: Every Spring Festival travel rush, railway passenger volume surges, and many migrant workers, students and people visiting relatives all hope to return home as soon as possible.

sentences.l2: 尤其在春节前后，车站候车厅里总是挤满拖着行李的人，归乡的心情格外急切。
sentences.l1: Especially around the Spring Festival, the station waiting halls are always packed with people dragging luggage, and the mood of heading home is particularly urgent.

sentences.l2: 由于热门线路的车票供不应求，抢票便成为一场与时间赛跑的行动。
sentences.l1: Because tickets on popular routes are in short supply, grabbing tickets becomes a race against time.

sentences.l2: 人们通常提前打开12306，反复刷新车次，并比较高铁和普通列车的时间、价格与余票。
sentences.l1: People usually open 12306 in advance, refresh the train listings repeatedly, and compare the times, prices and remaining tickets of high-speed and ordinary trains.

sentences.l2: 一旦车票开售，许多人会同时点击购票，希望抢到最合适的一班。
sentences.l1: Once tickets go on sale, many people click to buy at the same time, hoping to grab the most suitable train.

sentences.l2: 若未能立即购得车票，旅客还可以提交候补订单，等待系统自动匹配退票或新增席位。
sentences.l1: If they fail to get a ticket right away, passengers can also submit a waitlist order and wait for the system to automatically match returned tickets or newly added seats.

sentences.l2: 对大多数人而言，春运不仅是一次旅行，更是一次与团圆有关的安排，因此抢票背后承载的是对家的期待。
sentences.l1: For most people, the Spring Festival travel rush is not only a journey but also an arrangement connected with family reunion, so what lies behind grabbing tickets is longing for home.
